messages:
olivia: Quick heads-up 1: we have 3 incoming open models to fold into the catalog this sprint: Tethys-3B, Cirrus-7B, Halcyon-13B. Need final owners, licenses attached, and a small perf matrix (latency + cost) for launch gating. Who can grab which? :mag:
rene: I can run perf for Tethys and Cirrus. Question: do we want both fp16 and quantized runs (q4/q8) or only q8? I think both fp16 and q8 to compare P95 and token cost.
sam: Intake update 1: Cirrus license is already in the bucket (s3://licenses/cirrus-7b-v2.pdf). Tethys license pending sign-off from upstream. Halcyon has vendor paperwork that looks nonstandard1—need legal eyes.
marta: Legal check 1: Cirrus ok. Tethys awaits a contributor agreement from their org; Ive reached out and expect a reply in ~48 hours. Halcyon: vendor requires DPA + provenance log for weights. ETA 3 business days to get the DPA reviewed.
kevin: Runtime notes: Halcyon claims a 32K context mode; that will change our KV/cache plan. If we enable the long-context path we should disable some kernel fusions. For perf baselines, we should do fp16 and q8 for each, and a 16k/32k shape check for Halcyon.
rene: Plan for perf runs:
# local perf runner
run_perf --model tethys-3b --preset fp16 --seq 2048 --batch 4 --out perf/tethys_fp16.json
run_perf --model tethys-3b --preset q8 --seq 2048 --batch 8 --out perf/tethys_q8.json
run_perf --model cirrus-7b --preset fp16 --seq 2048 --batch 4 --out perf/cirrus_fp16.json
run_perf --model cirrus-7b --preset q8 --seq 2048 --batch 8 --out perf/cirrus_q8.json
I'll upload outputs to #perf-results by EOD tomorrow unless something breaks.
sam: I'll take ownership for Tethys intake (manifests, license follow-ups, tokenization checks). I'll also run quick tokenization sanity and embedding dim checks.
ingest-bot: Manifest uploaded: /manifests/tethys-3b-manifest-v1.json (sha256: fa12b3c4...)
marta: @sam please append the upstream approval thread to that manifest once it arrives. If Halcyon vendor can't produce the DPA, we cannot include it in the public catalog without legal sign-off.
kevin: Routing suggestion draft (will update after perf results):
routing:
  model: tethys-3b
  preferred: dedicated_p4_pool
  fallback: small_batch_low_latency_pool
  long_context_mode: disabled  # enable only if 32k perf acceptable
olivia: Nice. Summarized action items below1:
- sam: owner for Tethys intake + attach upstream clearance when available 1 due 72h
- rene: perf matrix for Tethys & Cirrus (fp16 + q8) 1 results by EOD tomorrow
- marta: chase legal on Tethys contributor agreement and start DPA review for Halcyon 1 update in 3 business days
- kevin: routing + pool recommendation after perf results
- ingest-bot: ensure manifests are linked to intake board
If timelines slip, drop a quick update in-thread so product can adjust the launch board. I'll collect everything and post a short launch-readout on Friday. :white_check_mark:
rene: Acknowledged 1 will flag failures and post perf JSONs to #perf-results
sam: Taking Tethys now. I'll also validate tokenization shapes and check embedding vector dimension compatibility with our embed-store.
marta: Looping in vendor legal contact (cc: vendor-legal@halcyon.ai) 1 will post any updates here. :eyes:
kevin: Added a short note in devnotes about long-context tradeoffs and compilation flags. Will refine after perf.
olivia: Thanks everyone. If anyone needs a hand with infra or test tokens, ping me. Closing loop in 48 hours unless blockers surface.
